status: PROPOSED budgets, re-baselined 2026-10-24 to the measured size plus about 1.5 kB (the quiz and cart groups keep their earlier, higher numbers because budgets are never reduced); still pending client approval (Q-012, NFR-002). Earlier baselines: about 5 percent above the 2026-10-16 build after the P7-06 lazy-loading, and the analytics consent chunk (P7-01) then used most of that margin. Rule: a feature that needs more than the headroom must split code, or justify the increase and re-baseline with a recorded decision. See docs/testing/PERFORMANCE.md.
unit: kB of gzip (level 9) JavaScript needed to start the route on a cold load, entry and root included. A group's budget applies to each of its routes, so the largest route sets the headroom.
